# Release Notes for the Latest Version of Disruption January 07, 2025

The Network360 Team is excited to announce updates designed to enhance your experience with the Disruption platform. Here’s what’s new in this release:

* Display Provider Name with NPI/TIN Match
* Improved Navigation for Processing Files

## Enhancements

### 1.	Display Provider Name with NPI/TIN Match

The Provider Name now appears in the Providers tab when either NPI or TIN matches, even if the provider’s name is not mapped.

**Access:** To view, click on Analysis and go to Providers tab.

**Benefit:** Simplifies provider identification for unmatched records.

### 2.	Improved Navigation for Processing Files

Clicking “Back” from the View File Details or Edit File pages now takes you directly to the Processing Files page.

**Benefit:** Enhances user navigation making file management more efficient.

## Conclusion

This release introduces provider name display with NPI/TIN matches and streamlines navigation within the Processing Files section. These updates are designed to enhance your workflow and simplify the user experience. For any questions or assistance, please contact our support team.
